paite: Hauhsakna thupite sang in minhoih tel zawk ding ahi, dangka leh dangka-eng sang in deihsakna a-ithuai zaw hi.
english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

paite: Hausa leh genthei akituakkhawm ua, amaute bawl TOUPA ahi.
english: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.

paite: Mipilvang in hoih lou amu a, akibu hi. Himahleh mimawl in aphu zel a, athuakloh hi.
english: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

paite: Kiniamkhiakna leh TOUPA kihtakna loh tak hauhsaknate, zahtakhuaina leh hinna ahi.
english: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.

paite: Lingte leh thangte mihoih lou lampi ah a-om; kuapeuh akha kem in huaite agamlat ding hi.
english: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

paite: Apaina ding lampi ah naupang chil in, huan a-upat hun nangawn in leng huai a kipan apial kei ding hi.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

paite: Mihau in genthei tung ah vai ahawm a, huan leitawisakmi a ding in leitawimi sikha ahi.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

paite: Kuapeuh thulimlouhna tuh in tuahsia ala ding; huan ahehna chiang alohching kei ding.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

paite: Kuapeuh khuttawi lian mit nei vualzawl in a-om ding; migenthei kiang a atanghou a kipan apiak ziak in.
english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

paite: Muhsit hatmi delhkhia in, huan kinakna apaikhe ding hi; ahi, kisualna leh zumhuaina atawp ding hi.
english: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

paite: Kuapeuh lungtang sianthouna it, amukte deihhuaina ziak in kumpipa alawm ahi ding hi.
english: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

paite: Theihna nei amah TOUPA mit in avomhoih ding, himahleh lepchiahmi thute apai ahi.
english: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

paite: Thadah in, polam ah humpinelkai a-om; kongzing ah thah in a-om ding, achi hi.
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

paite: Numei lamdangte kam kokhuk thuk ahi; kuapeuh TOUPA deihloumi huai ah akelut ding hi.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.

paite: Haina naupang lungtang sung ah henlop in a-om a; himahleh bawldikna chiang in amah a kipan gamlapi ah adelhkhe ding hi.
english: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

paite: Kuapeuh apunna khansakna ding a migenthei nuaisiah a, kuapeuh mihau kiang a pia, taksapna atung lel hi.
english: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

paite: Na bildoh inla, mipil thute za in, huan ka theihna lam ah na lungtang suk in.
heading: Thugen Pilhuai Sawmthum
english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

paite: Na sung a na kepleh thil nuam ahi ngal a, na muk a hihkip khawm a a-omleh.
english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

paite: Na muanna TOUPA ah ahihtheihna ding in, tuni in na kiang ah, nang mahmah kiang ah ka theisak hi.
english: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in Yahweh.

paite: Thuphate leh theihna tungtang a thil hoih penpente na kiang ah ka gelh khinta kei maw.
english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

paite: Na kiang a thu hon dongte thutak a na dawntheihna ding a, thutak leh muanhuaite nang hon theisak hilou ka hi hiam?
english: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

paite: Agentheih ziak in, genthei lok ke'n, kongpi ah gimthuak leng nuaisiah sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Khatna
english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

paite: TOUPA'N lah athu uh agen sin ngal a, amau lokte hinna alok ding hi.
english: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

paite: Mihehbaih toh kizawl ke'nla, huan thangpaihhat mi toh kithuah ke'n.
heading: Thugen Nihna
english: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

paite: Alampite na sin kha dia, na kha a ding in thang na mu kha ding hi.
english: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

paite: Khutbengte lak a khat hi ke'nla, ahihkeileh leibate ziak a mohkhu a pangte lak a leng hi sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Thumna
english: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

paite: Piak ding na neih keileh, bang ding a na nuai a kipan na lupna lamang ding ahia?
english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

paite: Na pipute koihkipsa, tang a gamgi suan ke'n.
heading: Thugen Lina
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

paite: Anasep a kizenmi na mu hia? Kumpipate ma ah adingh ding a; mithulimloute ma ah adingh kei ding hi.
heading: Thugen Ngana
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
